data_fields.name: hitHeightFrac
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.60 of TOP_OF_HEAD_HEIGHT, capped at target half height

data_fields.name: creatureBloodKind
data_fields.donor_constant: one byte per creature from creatureBlood[24] exe table (values not read)

best_idea: A hit effect is one short-lived event whose kind comes from a per-target data field, spawned at the hit point only when the server-confirmed hit landed, and removed when its clip ends.
decision_why: Frankendom needs the shape (kind from data, spawn at the hit point, self-remove at clip end) but the event must come from the server's confirmed hit, not a local swing; the donor's clank-on-miss is not copied without a ruling.
acceptance: A server-confirmed landed hit on a creature shows one blood clip at the hit point for frames/12 s, then it is gone; a killing blow shows blood and no clank; a server test asserts the client effect is emitted only from a server-confirmed hit event.
